newsitem.title: GREECE: Drachma up vs ecu, fx forwards firm, bonds range.
newsitem.headline: Drachma up vs ecu, fx forwards firm, bonds range.

text.p: Greek short-term depos opened up and forex forwards firmed on heavy borrowing of drachmas by a London-based player that helped push ecu/drachma up to around 309.60, dealers said.

Ecu/drachma opened around 309.50 and advanced to 309.58/63 as local players speculated that the London-based player would follow up his forex forward move with spot ecu/drachma buying, but ecu/drachma dipped when the central bank checked $/drachma.

Ecu/drachma is currently trading around 309.40/45 after another London-based bank closed out last week's long ecu/drachma position, selling about 30 to 40 million ecus for drachmas, forex dealers said.
"By checking $/drachma when ecu/drachma was rising, the central bank confirmed its commitment to the hard drachma policy," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank.
Short-term depos opened a tenth of a point firmer and were holding their morning levels around mid-session, while implied drachma rates from forex forwards surged 20 to 30 basis points, dealers said.
"Implied drachma rates from forex forwards are up 20 to 30 basis points on heavy drachma borrowing by a London-based player earlier on," said a dealer at a foreign bank.
The central bank offered to drain 14-day funds at 11.90 percent in its regular weekly depo tender. A pact of 100 billion drachmas for 14-day funds expires today.
A pact of about 97 billion drachmas for 5-day repo funds also expires today.
Bonds were little changed, with marginally higher bids on fixed coupon bonds, dealers said.

"There is very little movement in bonds and FRNs today," said a bond dealer at a foreign bank. "I think we have hit bottom or we are very close to it and this explains why we see slightly higher bids in fixed coupon bonds today."
Greece is to auction 150 billion drachmas of seven-year floaters on July 29.
The mark was quoted at 156.33/38 from Tuesday's 156.500 fix, the dollar at 285.46/56 drachmas from 283.610 and the ecu at 309.39/49 from 309.52 drachmas.
